question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
-- Use a nested CTE approach - first categorize, then count
WITH user_ages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id,
    CAST(birth_date AS DATE) as birth_date_cast,
    date_diff('year', CAST(birth_date AS DATE), CURRENT_DATE) as age_years
  FROM mst_users
),
categorized AS (
  SELECT user_id,
    age_years,
    CASE 
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
      WHEN age_years BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
      ELSE 'others'
    END as age_category
  FROM user_ages
)
SELECT 
  age_category,
  COUNT(*) as user_count
FROM categorized
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
  CASE age_category
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2
    WHEN '40s' THEN 3
    WHEN '50s' THEN 4
    WHEN 'others' THEN 5
  END
